cells.gaps: No source found says Morocco AI 2030 has been adopted or validated: the minister told parliament on 10 November 2026 that he was launching it. Digital Morocco 2030 names AI as one lever of a digital strategy, which does not count. No body named to carry it out has been found.
cells.note: Bill's ruling (messages-for-bill 132): a minister's launch is not adoption, and formal validation is needed. The minister launched the roadmap in November 2026 with no adoption stated, so stage 2.
